description: This file provides utility functions to add specific retry and fallback headers to response objects, primarily using the Pydantic BaseModel for response validation and modification.

methods.name: Any _add_headers_to_response(response: Any, headers: dict)
methods.description: Helper function that adds headers to a response's hidden parameters, supporting responses that are Pydantic models with hidden params.

methods.name: Any add_retry_headers_to_response( response: Any, attempted_retries: int, max_retries: Optional[int] = None, )
methods.description: Adds retry-related headers indicating the number of retry attempts and maximum retries to the response.

methods.name: Any add_fallback_headers_to_response( response: Any, attempted_fallbacks: int, )
methods.description: Adds fallback attempt headers to the response, indicating how many fallback attempts have been made.

ctags.name: add_retry_headers_to_response
ctags.signature: ( response: Any, attempted_retries: int, max_retries: Optional[int] = None, )
